name: Pidgin Hawaiian
world_status: accessible description is silent on stress

earlier_scan.source_named: Roberts, Julian M. 1996. A structural sketch of Pidgin Hawaiian (Glottolog med 177105); APiCS survey ch. 71 (read: phonology section covers segments only, no stress; no confirmed recordings exist).

sources.note: Nothing; consonant/vowel tables copied from APiCS survey; no stress statement.

sources.citation: Roberts, Sarah J. 2013. Pidgin Hawaiian. In Michaelis, Maurer, Haspelmath & Huber (eds.), The Survey of Pidgin and Creole Languages, vol. III. Oxford University Press. Read in the APiCS Online version (survey chapter 71, https://apics-online.info/surveys/71).
sources.note: Nothing. Section 4 'Phonology' covers the 5 vowels, up to 9 diphthongs, the 8-consonant inventory, glottal-stop loss and substrate allophony only, and states: 'since no confirmed recordings of Pidgin Hawaiian exist, it is not known whether length was phonemic since it was seldom represented orthographically'. No word on stress, accent or prosody.
